intro.what: Type a family surname and a research assistant searches the public web for several minutes, then draws what it found as a map of connected notes: origins, spelling variants, places, migrations and documented people.
intro.limit: A surname alone is shared by many unrelated families, so without more details the result is a map of the surname, not your own ancestry. Add relatives you know (names, places, approximate years) to make it about your family.
intro.privacy: The surname and the details you type here are sent to an AI research service. Living private people are left out of the results.

notConfigured.title: Genealogy Scan isn't available yet
notConfigured.body: This feature hasn't been switched on. Please check back later.

premiumRequired.title: Part of the Premium plan
premiumRequired.body: Genealogy Scan runs long research sessions, so it is included with Premium.

monthlyLimitReached.title: This month's scans are used up
monthlyLimitReached.body: You have used {used} of {limit} scans this month. More will be available next month.

scanInProgress.title: A scan is already running
scanInProgress.body: You can start another one when it finishes.

form.heading: Start a scan
form.surnameHint: Letters, spaces, apostrophes, dots and hyphens.
form.anchorsHint: Up to 8. Each one helps the research find your family among everyone who shares the surname.
form.name: Full name
form.yearHint: A birth year or any year you know they were alive.
form.maxAnchors: You can add up to {max} relatives.
form.consent: Starting sends the surname and these details to the AI research service and uses one of this month's scans.

issues.invalidCharacters: Use only letters, spaces, apostrophes, dots and hyphens, starting with a letter.
issues.invalidYear: Enter a four-digit year, no later than this year.

list.title: Your scans
list.empty: You haven't run a scan yet.
list.nodes: {count, plural, =0 {No notes yet} one {# note} other {# notes}}
list.links: {count, plural, =0 {No links} one {# link} other {# links}}
list.deleteBody: The scan and its graph will be removed. This can't be undone.
list.deleteRunningBody: This scan is still running. Deleting it stops the research and removes what was found so far. This can't be undone.
list.filteredEmpty: No notes match the current filters.

running.title: Researching {surname}…
running.body: This usually takes several minutes. You can leave and come back: the graph appears here as soon as the first results arrive.
running.banner: {count, plural, one {Still researching. # note so far.} other {Still researching. # notes so far.}}

failed.title: This scan couldn't be completed
failed.body: The research stopped before it produced a result. You can start again.
failed.partial: The research stopped early. These are partial results.

empty.title: Nothing was found
empty.body: The research finished without results for this surname.

notify.hint: Turns on Genealogiq notifications on this device. Scans don't send their own alert yet, so check back in a few minutes.
notify.enabled: Notifications are on for this device.
notify.unsupported: Notifications aren't available on this device.
notify.unavailable: Notifications couldn't be turned on right now.

controls.hint: Tap a note to read it. Pinch to zoom, drag to move.

legend.title: Legend and filters
legend.help: Tap an item to show or hide it on the graph and in the list.

confidenceMeaning.documented: A record or reputable reference states this directly.
confidenceMeaning.probable: Several sources point the same way, but none states it outright.
confidenceMeaning.speculative: A lead worth checking, not an established fact.

summary.title: {surname}: summary
summary.noSummary: No overview was written for this scan.

tree.title: Add to my family tree
tree.explain: This creates a new person in your own family tree from this note. Check the details and choose how this person is related to you. Nothing is saved until you confirm.
tree.approximate: The scan marks these years as approximate.
tree.yearNote: Only the year is known, so it is saved as 1 January of that year. You can correct the date in your tree.
tree.relationRequired: Choose how this person is related to you.
tree.invalidYear: Enter a four-digit year, no later than this year.
tree.deathBeforeBirth: The death year can't be before the birth year.
tree.speculativeWarning: This note is speculative: no source confirms it. Add it only if you have your own evidence.
tree.confirmTitle: Add this person to your tree?
tree.confirmBody: {name} will be added to your family tree. Relation to you: {relation}.
tree.added: {name} was added to your family tree.

a11y.canvas: Graph with {nodes} notes and {edges} links. Switch to the list to read the notes one by one.
